<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def read_pink(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(''.join('#' if a[52+r][15+c*7+j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(5)) for r in range(5)) for c in range(5))
def cursor(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>=6:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if 14<=min(cols) and max(cols)<=48 and min(rows)>=47:
                return (min(cols)+max(cols))//2
    return None
print("cursor:", cursor(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("cursor:", cursor(current_frame))
p1=read_pink(current_frame)
seq=[]
for i in range(7):
    action(['UP']); seq.append(read_pink(current_frame))
print("pos1 cycle:")
for k in range(7):
    print(k, [seq[k][1][r] for r in range(5)])
print("back to start:", read_pink(current_frame)==p1)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
